subject: English Home Language

source.topic: Wild animals and sport: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'l' sound at the beginning of words (lion, leg, leaf, lamp)

show.line: Listen. l as in lion. l, l, lion. The lion licks its paw. l, l, leg!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with l, as in lion?
Say the sound with me. l, as in lion!

rounds.story: Lebo lifts her leg and kicks the ball. Which body part does Lebo lift?

rounds.prompt: Which animal starts with l? l, l.
What is this? It starts with l.
Does it start with l? Put l words in the l group.

hints: Listen for l at the start. l, l, lion.
Put your tongue up behind your teeth. l, l.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with l.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Zebra starts with z. Lion starts with l.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. l, l, lion. Lion starts with l!

parent_line: Can hear the l sound at the start of words.
